title: Royal Ballistix — Beach Siege
description: Radial ball-deflection survival for 2–10 contestants, one local human plus bots. Saved setup, 1/3/5-crown siege and timed defense practice; touch, keyboard and gamepad; coastal castle court, accurate volley/cannon guides and persistent audio/access preferences. Camera/CAM hooks remain available. Phone/network transport is not integrated.
